Description: A small hollow hidden behind a curtain of hanging roots. Past it, the walls thin and a pale, steady light seeps through - the glow of the obelisk. This is the last place to stop and prepare before the way out.

Replies.SsText: You bind your wounds and share what rations remain. The hum fades to a whisper as you rest.

Replies.ReplyText: Pay a scavenger to reforge your gear.
Replies.SsText: The scavenger's tools ring against your gear. When she is done, something is better than before.

Replies.ReplyText: Study the hive's walls for a way to survive the return.
Replies.FlText: The hum grows overwhelming and you flee with a pounding headache.
Replies.SsText: You study the walls and learn where the hive is thinnest. The knowledge will serve you well.
